title: Chart with notes
description: « Image interactive » in the course's folio style: a large figure with markers set on it, each named by a few words (a question someone asked about that spot) and numbered; selecting a marker shows its note under the figure, on a leaf of vellum, in the room of the longest. Markers already read carry a gilt dot. In narrow places the notes are a numbered list under the figure.
instructions: Three to five markers, each a short phrase on the figure (marker, two or three words), a title (the question, in the visitor's words) and one to three sentences (the answer). x and y from 0 to 1 of the whole picture, on the spot itself.

presentation.description: below: the notes under the figure, one at a time (the only presentation of this style).

marker.description: The words on the marker, two or three (the note's title says the rest).

items.title: “There is no north on this map”
items.markdown: The pilot turns the chart to face the course.
